steps.title: Three clear steps from searching to care.

items.title: Clarify what you are looking for
items.text: Start with a service, concern, or therapist profile that sounds closest to what is happening now.

items.title: Review clinician information
items.text: Compare who they work with, focus areas, approaches, and whether you prefer in-person or online care.

items.title: Schedule your next step
items.text: Book a free 10-minute consultation or move directly into the appropriate first clinical appointment.

faq.title: Answers before you schedule.

items.question: Can I talk with a therapist before starting?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a free 10-minute phone meet-and-greet so you can ask practical questions and get a feel for the clinician before deciding what to do next.

items.question: Can I start with a full session instead?
items.answer: Yes. For individual clients, the standard clinical starting point may be a 53-minute diagnostic evaluation when appropriate.

items.question: Do you offer online therapy?
items.answer: Yes. Secure telehealth may be available to eligible clients who are physically located in Washington at the time of care.

items.question: How do I check insurance benefits?
items.answer: [Email support@mft.care](mailto:support@mft.care?subject=Verify%20my%20therapy%20benefits) to start a benefits-verification request. Coverage depends on the clinician, service, plan, and network status.

faq.contact: Still unsure? [Ask our support team a question.](mailto:support@mft.care?subject=Website%20question)
